answers.quote: The Golden Plateau gold mine in Queensland ceased operations in 1993 because the ore grades had fallen to levels that made extraction economically unviable. By the early 1990s, the mine’s production costs exceeded the revenue from the gold it could recover, prompting the company to shut down the ope

survey.answer: Golden Plateau (Geological Survey of Queensland site 493636) is recorded as an abandoned mine on the Cracow 1:100,000 sheet (1.59km nnw of cracow, 173.21km se of gladstone.), at -25.2837, 150.2920, located to within 100 m. The survey classes its gold as medium, 5-50 t, and also records silver (small). Within 5 km it records 58 other historical workings, 58 of them with gold; other commodities nearby: copper, silver. The record gives a size band, not production figures, and holds no owners or closure dates.
sources: Geological Survey of Queensland, MINOCC historical workings (CC BY 4.0, State of Queensland), site 493636: https://spatial-gis.information.qld.gov.au/arcgis/rest/services/GeoscientificInformation/MiningResources/MapServer/16/query?where=site_no%3D493636&outFields=%2A&f=json
survey.brief: Golden Plateau: abandoned mine, gold medium

structured_record.answer: Golden Plateau (GSQ site 493636, 1.59km nnw of cracow, 173.21km se of gladstone) is recorded by the Geological Survey of Queensland as abandoned mine, gold size band medium, 5 - 50 t. Reported production: 25,233 kg gold, about 811,260 oz troy (converted here; the survey records 25,233 kg) (1934 to 1993, Golden Plateau, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 493636)); 20,792 kg silver (1934 to 1993, Golden Plateau, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 493636)); 2,625,632 tonnes ore (1934 to 1993, Golden Plateau, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Total_Ores_Prod, SITE_NO 493636)). GSQ MINOCC 2017 also lists 7 dated Production rows (gold: 19,081 kg 1934 to 1976; 1,143 kg 1987 to 1988; 1,192 kg 1988 to 1989; 1,166 kg 1989 to 1990; 1,371 kg 1990 to 1991; 733 kg 1991 to 1992; 547 kg 1992 to 1993); see production. Closure: 1993 (no reason quoted) [Golden Plateau, unknown, per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (MineHist, SITE_NO 493636, row 4)]. Years worked per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (MineHist, SITE_NO 493636): 1932-1976, 1987-1993. Ownership and tenure: Lion Mining Pty Ltd per GSQ MINOCC 2017 (Tenure, SITE_NO 493636); Aeris Resources Limited per GA-MINERALDEPOSITS-335572. Not found: closure reason: the indexed sources give a closure year but quote no reason.
